description: Log 7 nights of sleep against your target to find your sleep debt and a recovery plan.

faqs.a: The gap between the sleep you need and the sleep you got, summed over days. One short night creates a small debt; a week of them compounds.
Add up to 1 extra hour per night and keep a consistent bedtime — this tool builds that catch-up plan for you.
faqs.q: How do I repay sleep debt?

faqs.a: Most adults need 7–9 hours. This tool defaults to 8 — adjust it to what leaves you feeling rested.
faqs.q: How much sleep do I need?

faqs.a: Naps under 30 minutes and weekend lie-ins help a little, but consistent nightly sleep repays debt best.

howto: Set your nightly sleep target in hours.
Enter hours slept for each of the last 7 days.
Follow the suggested extra-sleep recovery plan.
title: Sleep Debt Calculator
